thread:
Sam CSM: Heads-up — AcmeCorp renewal. They want to move from annual to quarterly billing and are asking for a 15% concession on list pricing. Procurement says it's their standard process. Can we confirm approach?
Ellie AE: Context — their CFO prefers quarterly POs to match internal cycles. Sales guideline is max 10% without exec signoff. Could we do 12% if they sign by end of week?
Raj Procurement: We can accept quarterly invoices but need: vendor W9, billing contact, and the PO in our template. Timeline: CFO said PO will be raised by 3/26 if legal and finance sign off.
Maya Finance: Quarterly invoicing ok from a cashflow perspective, net30 preferred. Note: anything >10% discount requires FP&A + RevOps signoff for ARR recognition impact.
Sam CSM: Tagging @LegalBot — can Legal create a short addendum to the contract for quarterly billing & payment schedule so procurement is comfortable? We also need a clause to protect Redwood if PO is delayed.
LegalBot: Draft addendum suggested:
```
Addendum A — Billing & Payment Schedule:
1) Customer elects quarterly invoicing in lieu of annual prepayment. Redwood will invoice Customer at the start of each quarter for the agreed quarterly amount.
2) Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice date.
3) If a signed PO is not received within 30 days of execution, Redwood reserves the right to revert pricing to the prior annual rate or suspend service after a 10-day cure period.
```
LegalBot: We should avoid language that creates a de facto trial. This addendum is narrow and reversible.
Ellie AE: If we can offer 12% contingent on PO by 3/26 and signature by 3/31, I can get the CFO to push. Is Redwood team ok with that contingency?
Maya Finance: 12% contingent is fine as an offer, but we need exec (VP Finance) approval to lock it in — I'll ping Jordan.
Raj Procurement: I'll circulate the PO template to Ellie and include procurement contact email: `procurement@acmecorp.com`. Also confirm vendor name and W9.
Sam CSM: Vendor name & W9 received from their ops lead earlier today — saved in the shared folder: https://redwood.share/acme/w9.pdf
Olivia Implementation: Heads-up for enablement — moving to quarterly affects billing dates for onboarding milestones. We can compress onboarding into 2 sessions instead of 3 to meet their go-live window, but need signoff on dates.
Ellie AE: I'll confirm go-live target with their PM. If they sign by 3/31 we can start onboarding week of 4/7.
DocusignBot: Draft ready and routed to Ellie for signature: https://docusign.com/txn/ABC123 — includes Addendum A as discussed.
Ellie AE: Sent to CFO at 09:12. Noted CFO asked for the 12% to be in the body with the contingency spelled out. I adjusted wording.
Raj Procurement: CFO confirmed PO will be raised by 3/26 with PO number `2026-AC-0451`. I'll upload when I get it.
Maya Finance: Jordan (VP Finance) approved the 12% exception for this account; he needs the final signed agreement and the PO before booking.
Sam CSM: Risk note — if PO or signature slips past 3/31, discount drops to 10% per sales policy. Please highlight to the CFO.
Ellie AE: CFO acknowledged the contingency and said they will try to get sign-off this week. Thanks for the fast turnaround, team. :thumbsup:
DocusignBot: Document signed by CFO (AcmeCorp) at 1753009955. Final signed PDF: https://docusign.com/txn/ABC123/final.pdf
Sam CSM: Great — upload signed doc + PO to the contract folder and update the renewal tracker. I'll schedule the kickoff with Olivia for 4/7.
Olivia Implementation: Got it — penciled in 4/7 for onboarding. Will send draft agenda after I see the signed agreement.
Ellie AE: PO uploaded to the shared drive and copied to this thread. Closing note: agreed 12% contingent, quarterly invoicing, net30, PO `2026-AC-0451` received, signed 3/25 by CFO.
Sam CSM: Closing thread — assigning post-sign enablement tasks and follow-ups in the tracker. Thanks everyone.
